title: Needle entry on the patient
view: Close-up of the lower face from the front, seated, patient's right on the image left; the right upper lip lifted by a gloved finger.
teachingPoint: Enter at the height of the mucobuccal fold above the tooth, the needle angled up along the tooth toward its root apex.
claims: Seated, face from the front, patient's right on the left (record positioning; house laterality).
Upper lip retracted to open the mucobuccal fold (record step 3).
Entry at the height of the fold above the right maxillary canine (record step 4; the canine is the default tooth).
Needle angled toward the root apex; its path under the mucosa dashed to just short of the apex (record steps 4-5).
Canine root about 17 mm long, its apex above the fold (standard anatomy; record: roots sit just above the fold).
Labels: Mucobuccal fold, Root apex, Needle.

geometry.why: the fold is above the tooth crown
the root apex sits above the fold
entry at the height of the fold
the apex is the tip of the canine root
the syringe comes up from below; the needle runs up toward the apex
